title: Psalms 93
paragraphs: ¹ The LORD reigns, he is robed in majesty; the LORD is robed in majesty and armed with strength; indeed, the world is established, firm and secure. ² Your throne was established long ago; you are from all eternity. ³ The seas have lifted up, LORD, the seas have lifted up their voice; the seas have lifted up their pounding waves. ⁴ Mightier than the thunder of the great waters, mightier than the breakers of the sea — the LORD on high is mighty. ⁵ Your statutes, LORD, stand firm; holiness adorns your house for endless days.
